purpose: Teach: 動脈/省令/偵察/定理/不合理/非行/射殺/勃発

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、動脈の詰まりを医療チームで監視しております
lines.en: Ren, we're monitoring the arterial blockage as a medical team.
lines.style: Steady, clinical opener. Clear enunciation on the medical term. Even tone, unhurried. The composure of someone delivering information she's delivered many times before.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、新省令に基づき医療チームで対応を変えております
lines.en: Yes, and we've adjusted our response protocols based on the new regulations.
lines.style: Slight nod in the voice. Measured cadence. Acknowledging his awareness without over-explaining. Warm but professional — the patience of someone used to explaining medical decisions to intelligent people.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 画像による偵察的検査を、貴院、なさってるんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital does use imaging for diagnostic screening, then, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, deferential opening. Genuine curiosity — he's thinking as he speaks. Slight uptick at the end, like a careful question being posed to someone he respects.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、循環の定理を医療チームで研修いたします
lines.en: Yes, the medical team trains together on circulation protocols.
lines.style: Calm, informative. No rush. Each phrase lands clearly. The voice of someone who knows this is important to the person asking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療現場の不合理を、貴院、改善されたそうですね、先生
lines.en: It sounds like your hospital has worked to fix some of the inefficiencies in medical practice, Doctor.
lines.style: Thoughtful, appreciative undertone. Slower pace. He's reflecting on what she's said, testing his understanding. A hint of respect — he's noticing her work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、非行少年の医療相談も医療チームで担当しております
lines.en: Yes, we also handle medical consultations for at-risk youth through the team.
lines.style: Consistent, steady. No change in her professional bearing. This is woven into the hospital's normal work for her — stated with the same care as everything else.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 救急で射殺事案を、貴院、診られたそうですね、先生
lines.en: I understand your hospital has also treated gunshot cases in emergency, Doctor.
lines.style: Respectful hesitation. Slower, more careful phrasing — he's acknowledging the weight of what he's asking. A note of gravity, not shock.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染症勃発時の備えを医療チームでしております
lines.en: Yes, we maintain preparedness protocols for infectious disease outbreaks as a team.
lines.style: Steady, professional close. Slight softening at the end — this is serious work, and she holds it seriously. No performance, just presence.
